name: Unstable Magic
summary: Archmage Celindra in Dalaran seeks field data for Archmage Rhonin, who is investigating a disturbance in Azeroth's magic. You are asked to gather motes of unstable magic with an Arcane Censer.

sections.title: Field Data
sections.body: Archmage Rhonin is abroad, studying a disturbance in the flow of magic across Azeroth. In Dalaran, Archmage Celindra asks you to gather motes that may aid his investigation. The Arcane Censer lets you draw them from skilled spell casters and other powerful beings; the Kirin Tor awaits the gathered data.

faq.q: Who is asking for the motes?
faq.answer: Archmage Celindra in Dalaran asks you to gather motes of unstable magic for Archmage Rhonin.

faq.q: Why does Rhonin need the motes?
faq.answer: Rhonin is investigating a disturbance in the flow of magic across Azeroth, and the motes provide field data for his work.

faq.q: What does the Arcane Censer do?
faq.answer: While its magic affects you, the Arcane Censer lets you extract motes of unstable magic from skilled spell casters and other powerful beings.

faq.q: Where do I bring the motes?
faq.answer: Bring the motes to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.

faq.q: How many motes does Celindra ask for?
faq.answer: Celindra asks you to bring ten motes of unstable magic.
